_note: Documented restrictions as rules: profile condition x tag (x side) -> block | caution. The engine is deterministic; no model decides a conflict. A block halts the program: 'documented restriction found, therapist decides'. A caution must appear in the patient line, so a dropped caution is an objection. side: the side the rule protects ('any' = every side; an item on 'both' sides matches left and right). Approved by Petri on the review page 14.10.2026: every row OK, S2.2 and the S2 dialogue changed on his comments (Atlas dec_053ef87aba2e4ce3).

conditions.en: Left below-knee (transtibial) amputation, early prosthetic phase
Prosthetist: no unsupervised single-leg weight-bearing on the left prosthesis while the socket is fitted
conditions.fi: Apuvälineteknikko: ei valvomatonta yhden jalan kuormitusta vasemmalla proteesilla holkin sovituksen aikana

conditions.en: Skin graft at the end of the left residual limb
Right shoulder pain on raising the arm (rotator cuff related)

rules.text: No jumping or running for now.
Stop before the knee is deeply bent.
Breathe out during the effort; do not hold your breath.
Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
No step-ups leading with the left prosthesis outside supervised sessions.
No kneeling on the left residual limb (skin graft).
No pressure on the end of the left residual limb (skin graft).
No hopping on the right leg.
Check the skin of the residual limb after wearing the prosthesis.
No loaded forward bending of the spine (osteoporosis).
Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
Avoid forceful twisting of the back.
Stay in a pain-free range; stop if the pain rises.
No hand weights in the right hand for now.
